title: Full Moon Sound Bath with Freqs of Love @ DRIFT
description: Full Moon Sound Bath with Freqs of Love @ DRIFT
long_description:
Elevate your frequency with high-vibrational soundscapes at the DRIFT studio oasis in downtown Seattle.

About this Event

Full Moon in Taurus Sound Bath.
Join us at DRIFT and take in the gorgeous surroundings in this soothing city oasis while being held in sacred sound. Let the vibrations of the crystal alchemy bowls, the deep resonance gongs, drums, and chimes clear away the old and make space for new.
The space is unlike any other and perfect for acoustic resonance, as it is a tiered sanctuary clad with natural, grounding textures. Crystal bowls vibrate with surround sound that dances around the candlelit room to bathe you in healing frequency...an event you won't want to miss for the vibes alone.
This full moon in Taurus calls us to focus on our material world, financial security, and personal comfort. It is a beautiful time to manifest stability and appreciate the fruits of your labor, while indulging in sensory experiences that bring joy. As this season is drawing to a close with the precious time of Samhain, we honor the sacred pause of stillness and dark that follows with renewal and rebirth in brighter days ahead.

Yoga Mats, neck pillows, and water provided. Bring a blanket, pillow, bolster, or whatever props will help you get the most cozy.
No prior experience with sound baths needed, first-timers welcome!Plan for parking around the studio - street parking and parking garages nearbyDoors open at 6:45pmStarts at 7:00pmDuration ~60 minutes with safe space share afterwardAges 14+
